info.name: BoiAro — Updated & New APIs (2026-06-03)
info.description:
Only the APIs that were CHANGED or ADDED in the current development session.

Summary:
— 4 New endpoints added
— 11 Existing endpoints changed (behavior, response shape, or validation)

Base URL: {{base_url}}/api/v1
Auth: Authorization: Bearer {{access_token}}

request.description:
ADDED: POST /api/v1/books/:id/read

Call this when the user opens or views a book. Increments the total_reads counter.

Auth: Optional
— Without token: just increments total_reads on the Book row
— With token: also creates a BookRead record for the user (used for 'Continue Reading' / personalization)

Response:
{
  "success": true,
  "total_reads": 342
}

Use case: call once per book open session, not on every page turn.

item.name: 🔁 CHANGED — Books: Get Book by ID

request.description:
CHANGED: GET /api/v1/books/:id

What changed:
rating, reviews_count, total_reads are now LIVE-COMPUTED from the database on every request instead of using stale cached column values.

Before (broken):
  rating: 0.0        ← cached column, never updated
  reviews_count: 0   ← cached column, never updated
  total_reads: 0     ← counter only incremented via web

After (fixed):
  rating: 4.5        ← avg of all APPROVED reviews
  reviews_count: 12  ← count of APPROVED reviews
  total_reads: 340   ← count from BookRead table

Key response fields:
{
  "id": "uuid",
  "title": "ভূত বউ",
  "title_en": "Ghost Wife",
  "slug": "bhoot-bou",
  "description": "...",
  "cover_url": "https://...",
  "rating": 4.5,           ← LIVE avg
  "reviews_count": 12,     ← LIVE count
  "total_reads": 340,      ← LIVE count
  "is_free": false,
  "language": "bn",
  "tags": ["horror", "romance"],
  "published_date": "2024-01-01",
  "author": { "id", "name", "avatar_url", "bio", "followed": true },
  "publisher": { "id", "name", "logo_url", "followed": false },
  "category": { "id", "name", "name_bn", "icon", "color" },
  "formats": [
    {
      "format": "ebook",
      "price": 99,
      "is_available": true,
      "preview_percentage": 20,
      "pages": 240,
      "file_size": "2.5 MB"
    },
    {
      "format": "audiobook",
      "price": 149,
      "is_available": true,
      "duration": "5:30:00",
      "chapters_count": 12
    }
  ]
}

item.name: 🔁 CHANGED — Books: Get Book by Slug

request.description:
CHANGED: GET /api/v1/books/slug/:slug

Same fix as Get Book by ID.
rating, reviews_count, total_reads are now live-computed.
Response shape identical to GET /books/:id.

CHANGED: GET /api/v1/books/:book_id/tracks

What changed:
When book.is_free = true OR audiobook format price = 0, ALL tracks now return:
  is_preview: true
  chapter_price: null

This means the app does NOT need to show any paywall for free books. The server handles it — no app update needed.

Response:
{
  "tracks": [
    {
      "id": "uuid",
      "track_number": 1,
      "title": "Episode 1 — শুরু",
      "duration": "12:34",
      "is_preview": true,     ← FREE: always true for free books
      "chapter_price": null,  ← FREE: always null for free books
      "media_type": "audio",
      "status": "active"
    }
  ]
}

For PAID books with mixed chapters:
{
  "tracks": [
    { "track_number": 1, "is_preview": true,  "chapter_price": null },
    { "track_number": 2, "is_preview": false, "chapter_price": 100 },
    { "track_number": 3, "is_preview": false, "chapter_price": 100 }
  ]
}

Logic:
  is_preview: true  → play freely, no coin deduction
  is_preview: false → require coin unlock before playback

item.name: 🔁 CHANGED — Wallet: Unlock Content with Coins

request.description:
CHANGED: POST /api/v1/wallet/unlock

What changed:
For audiobook chapter unlocks (format = 'audiobook_chapter_<track_id>'), the server now:
1. Fetches the REAL chapter_price from the DB
2. Ignores the client-supplied coin_cost for chapters
3. Validates the book_id matches the track
4. Forces coin_cost = 0 if book is free or track is preview

Before (broken): client could send coin_cost: 0 to unlock any chapter for free
After (fixed): server always uses the actual DB price

Format values:
  'ebook'                       → unlock full ebook
  'audiobook'                   → unlock full audiobook
  'audiobook_chapter_<id>'      → unlock single chapter (price from DB)
  'premium_voice'               → unlock AI TTS voice

Request:
{
  "book_id": "<book_uuid>",
  "format": "audiobook_chapter_<track_uuid>",
  "coin_cost": 100    ← only used for ebook/audiobook format; ignored for chapters
}

Response (success):
{ "success": true, "message": "Content unlocked", "new_balance": 150 }

Response (already unlocked):
{ "already_unlocked": true }

Errors:
  400  Insufficient coins
  400  Chapter not found
  400  Chapter does not belong to this book
  403  This book requires an active subscription
  400  Coin price not configured — contact admin

CHANGED: POST /api/v1/subscriptions/subscribe

What changed:
Paid plans now require actual payment before the subscription is activated.
Previously, subscriptions were activated immediately regardless of payment.

=== FLOW A: Free plan or 100% coupon ===
Request:
{
  "plan_id": "<uuid>",
  "coupon_code": "FREE100"
}

Response (immediate activation):
{
  "requires_payment": false,
  "subscription": {
    "id": "uuid",
    "status": "active",
    "start_date": "2026-06-03T...",
    "end_date": "2026-07-03T..."
  }
}

=== FLOW B: Paid plan ===
Request:
{
  "plan_id": "<uuid>",
  "payment_method": "sslcommerz"
}

Response (requires payment):
{
  "requires_payment": true,
  "gateway_url": "https://sandbox.sslcommerz.com/...",
  "subscription_id": "uuid",
  "transaction_id": "SUB-1717382400-abc123"
}

Mobile flow for paid:
1. Call subscribe → get gateway_url
2. Open gateway_url in WebView
3. User pays on SSLCommerz
4. Server receives callback → activates subscription automatically
5. App polls GET /subscriptions/active to confirm activation

Subscription status values:
  pending    → created, payment not yet received
  active     → payment confirmed, access granted
  failed     → payment failed
  cancelled  → user cancelled

CHANGED: GET /api/v1/tts/access/:bookId

What changed:
Previously always returned unlocked: true (security bug).
Now performs a real DB check — validates whether user has an active ContentUnlock for premium_voice.

Response:
{
  "success": true,
  "premium_voice_enabled": true,
  "unlocked": false,        ← true only if user has valid unlock record OR book is free
  "access_type": "paid",   ← 'free' | 'paid' | 'subscription'
  "coin_price": 200,        ← null if access_type is 'free'
  "wallet_balance": 45,     ← user's current coin balance
  "message": "Unlock with 200 coins to use AI voice"
}

access_type values:
  free          → no coins needed, all users can use TTS
  paid          → one-time coin unlock required
  subscription  → active subscription required

If unlocked: true → user can immediately call /tts/generate
If unlocked: false → show coin price and unlock button

CHANGED: POST /api/v1/tts/unlock

What changed:
Previously trusted client-supplied coin_cost, allowing free unlocks when voice_coin_price was null.
Now fetches the REAL price from the DB. Client sends only book_id.

Request:
{
  "book_id": "<uuid>"
  // No coin_cost needed — server fetches real price
}

Response (success):
{
  "success": true,
  "coins_spent": 200,
  "message": "Premium voice unlocked"
}

Response (already unlocked):
{
  "success": true,
  "already_unlocked": true
}

Errors:
  400  Premium Voice not enabled for this book
  400  Coin price not configured — contact admin
  400  Insufficient coins
  403  This book requires an active subscription

item.name: 🔁 CHANGED — Authors: Get by ID (new fields)

request.description:
CHANGED: GET /api/v1/authors/:id

What changed:
3 new fields added to the response:
  followers_count  — total follower count
  books_count      — total approved books
  is_following     — whether the current user follows this author (null if not authenticated)

Also: books list now has NO limit — returns ALL books by this author.

Full response:
{
  "id": "uuid",
  "name": "রবীন্দ্রনাথ ঠাকুর",
  "name_en": "Rabindranath Tagore",
  "avatar_url": "https://...",
  "bio": "...",
  "genre": "Poetry, Fiction",
  "is_featured": true,
  "followers_count": 1250,  ← NEW
  "books_count": 15,        ← NEW
  "is_following": false,    ← NEW (null if not logged in)
  "books": [
    { "id", "title", "title_en", "slug", "cover_url", "rating", "is_free" }
  ]  // All books, no limit
}

CHANGED: POST /upload/media

What changed:
1. WAV audio files are now accepted (previously rejected)
2. S3 upload timeout increased from 15s to 300s (fixes large file failures)
3. Returns upload progress events (when called from mobile with XHR)

Accepted file types:
  Audio:  MP3, M4A, WAV, MP4   (max 500 MB)
  Ebook:  EPUB, PDF            (max 500 MB)
  Image:  JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF  (max 500 MB)

Request:
  Content-Type: multipart/form-data
  Field name:   file

Response:
{
  "url": "https://r2.boiaro.com/media/audio/track-001.wav",
  "storage": "s3",
  "queued": false
}

Error responses:
  413  File too large (exceeds 500 MB)
  415  Unsupported file type: <mime>

item.name: 🆕 NEW — Notifications: Register FCM Push Token

request.description:
ADDED: POST /api/v1/notifications/register-token

Register the device's Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) token to receive push notifications.

Call this:
— On every app launch after a successful login
— After the user grants notification permission

Request:
{
  "token": "<fcm_token_from_firebase>",
  "platform": "android"   ← 'android' | 'ios'
}

Response:
{
  "success": true,
  "push_enabled": true,
  "firebase_configured": true
}

If push_enabled: false → push notifications are disabled platform-wide by admin
If firebase_configured: false → Firebase not set up on the server yet

The same token can be re-registered safely (idempotent).
Multiple devices per user are supported.

ADDED: DELETE /api/v1/notifications/register-token

Remove the device token so the user no longer receives push notifications on this device.

Call this on logout to prevent push notifications being sent to a logged-out device.

Response:
{
  "success": true
}
